description: Fetch labelled figures from any STAT-TAB table. 'selection' maps variables (code or label, case/accents ignored) to values (codes or labels); '*' = all values, 'latest' / 'latest:5' = last period(s), '2015-2020' = year range. Unspecified variables default to their total (e.g. 'Schweiz', 'Total') or the latest period, and the response lists every default applied. Max 5000 cells per query. Returns rows like {Kanton:'Zürich', value:1605508} plus 'fixed' for single-valued dimensions. Example: {table_id:'px-x-0102010000_101', selection:{Jahr:['latest'], Kanton:['Zürich','Bern'], Geschlecht:['*']}}.

include_codes.description: Also return value codes next to labels

lang.description: Language of titles/labels: de, fr, it or en (default en)

name: query_bfs_table
title: Query data from a BFS STAT-TAB table
